evals.prompt: Write an ADR recording that the backoffice stays on Node 24
assertions: uses the next free number in docs/adr/ with the NNN-title.md pattern
includes context, options, decision outcome, consequences and Confirmation

evals.prompt: Record the decision to refuse implicit account linking

evals.prompt: Supersede ADR 007 with a new ops data source decision
assertions: links both ways and updates the old status
